Carr Form A prints no schedule total.

expenditures.detail: One Form B row, 112.75, equals the cover's line-3 CUMULATIVE cell 112.75 - the only line-3 cell the filer filled (LAST and THIS are blank), so the cumulative cell is the sole anchor and the rows are on the cumulative scope. Carr Form B prints no schedule total.

gates.page_subtotal: Form prints no schedule total or page subtotal. p2: empty schedule, cover line-1 CUM 0. p3: rows sum 112.75 = cover line-3 CUMULATIVE 112.75 - closes exactly.

gates.geometry_proof: p3 600 dpi crop of the row-1 amount cell (x4180,y590,W800,H280) renders '112.75' under the 'Amount' header rule; the control crop one row-pitch below (y870,H200) renders EMPTY; a third 600 dpi full-width crop of the same band renders 'Cache County Clerk | filing fee' with the DATE cell visibly EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4 CUMULATIVE reads 0 (LAST and THIS blank). The chain does not close as a cash balance: contributions 0 - expenditures 112.75 = -112.75, not 0. Filer's own figure, retained verbatim. Cross-filing: the same filer's later Dec. 2 2020 report (key 0126d700) carries the SAME cumulative figures (0 / 0 / 112.75 / 0) but leaves its line-3 TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT cell blank, so the LAST-column chain cannot be tested; the two cumulative figures agree at 112.75.
